title: CIA v1 error body (CANDIDATE, CIA-S0)
description: Every non-2xx answer of the consumer API. No free text. HTTP: invalid_request 400, unauthenticated 401, consumer_not_allowed 403 (credential, scope, channel, channel account or purpose outside the consumer's allowlist: a configuration error, never a customer state), idempotency_conflict 409, rate_limited 429 (identical for every limit), dependency_unavailable 503, delivery_unavailable 503.
